screen.delvefold.setup.terrain.title: CHOOSE THE WORLD SHAPE
screen.delvefold.setup.terrain.help: Terrain is the permanent foundation of this mining world. You can change it later only through a confirmed recreation.
screen.delvefold.setup.terrain.detail.fl: Flat — layered, predictable geology for efficient branch mining and automation.
screen.delvefold.setup.terrain.detail.ca: Cavern — an enclosed cave network with a solid roof and underground atmosphere.
screen.delvefold.setup.terrain.detail.wi: Wild — hills, valleys, caves, and an Overworld-like exploration experience.
screen.delvefold.setup.terrain.scale.exp: Expansive uses deeper or amplified generation.
screen.delvefold.setup.terrain.seed_mode: Stable reproduces the same ore and landmark layout when this world is recreated.
Rotate on recreation gives each recreated world a new deterministic ore and landmark layout.
screen.delvefold.setup.ore_help.vanilla_: Familiar vanilla-style heights and rarity; edit or replace the profile later.
screen.delvefold.setup.ore_help.rich: The balanced layout with twice the placement attempts for resource-heavy play.
screen.delvefold.setup.ore_help.empty: No ore rules at initialization; build the complete profile yourself.
screen.delvefold.setup.gameplay_help.saf: No natural mob spawning; commands, eggs, breeding, and spawners still work.
screen.delvefold.setup.gameplay_help.hos: Hostile and ambient natural spawning only.
screen.delvefold.setup.gameplay_help.nor: All supported natural spawn categories are enabled.
screen.delvefold.setup.landmark_help.pur: Disables survey stations, motherlodes, and fault lines for uninterrupted mining.
screen.delvefold.setup.landmark_help.bal: Adds survey stations, motherlodes, and fault lines at a reduced frequency.
screen.delvefold.setup.landmark_help.abu: Adds all enabled landmark types at their full placement frequency.
